pk.context: 5 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

tell: Its delayed-release tablet lags about 4 hours behind immediate-release, pushing median peak exposure to 6 to 6.5 hours.

clues.text: Food significantly affects absorption of this product, and fasting bioavailability is significantly lower. It is a prodrug whose metabolism is mainly hepatic, with conjugates excreted in urine.
Molecular weight 358.43. An odorless crystalline powder that is very slightly soluble in water.
An NDA product of 1 mg, 2 mg and 5 mg delayed-release tablets, sold in bottles of 30 or 100.
No boxed warning; contraindicated with known hypersensitivity to it or its excipients. Fluid retention and altered glucose tolerance are among the common adverse reactions.
Severe allergic conditions and many dermatologic, rheumatologic and respiratory diseases, certain endocrine conditions, palliation of some cancers, and organ transplantation.
A synthetic adrenocortical steroid with potent anti-inflammatory effects that modify the body's immune responses to diverse stimuli.
The generic name begins with P and has ten letters.
